# Linewire

> Free Sunday email (7am CT): biggest betting line moves since open, steam vs reverse line movement, PrizePicks/Underdog/Pick6 notes and one clear call. Paid daily digests: betting line moves, DFS picks, and your line watchlist — plus price alerts on Edge. Public data only.
